title: Greetings & Imperative Actions 👋
rule: Imperative Actions: Use base verb forms directly to express direct actions or commands ([Verb] + [Object]). Example: 'Open the door'. Greetings combine an opening word with an action.

examples.context: Greeting an NPC and taking immediate action on an object.

examples.text: 🔑 Take the key and open the door.

targetLang.en: 🔑 Take the key and open the door.
targetLang.fr: 🔑 Prenez la clé et ouvrez la porte.
targetLang.es: 🔑 Toma la llave y abre la puerta.
targetLang.it: 🔑 Prendi la chiave e apri la porta!
targetLang.de: 🔑 Nimm den Schlüssel und öffne die Tür.

examples.context: Executing direct action sequences in cause-and-effect chains.

interactiveExercises.question: Which imperative phrase tells someone to unlock the entrance?
interactiveExercises.explanation: Imperative verbs start with the base form of the verb without suffixes.

interactiveExercises.question: Reorder words to form a polite imperative greeting:
interactiveExercises.explanation: Start with greeting, followed by base verb and direct object.

dialogues.grammarUsage: Imperative direct command used in living room tutorial.

title: Existential Placement & Identification 🛋️
rule: Existential Statements: Use 'There is' (+ singular) or 'There are' (+ plural) to point out the presence of objects in a scene. Pattern: [There is/are] + [Article] + [Noun] + [Location].

examples.text: 🛋️ There is a comfortable sofa in the living room.

targetLang.en: 🛋️ There is a comfortable sofa in the living room.
targetLang.fr: 🛋️ Il y a un canapé confortable dans le salon.
targetLang.es: 🛋️ Hay un sofá cómodo en el salón.
targetLang.it: 🛋️ C'è un divano comodo nel salotto.
targetLang.de: 🛋️ Es gibt ein bequemes Sofa im Wohnzimmer.

examples.text: ☕ There is a hot espresso on the table.

targetLang.en: ☕ There is a hot espresso on the table.
targetLang.fr: ☕ Il y a un café chaud sur la table.
targetLang.es: ☕ Hay un café caliente sobre la mesa.
targetLang.it: ☕ C'è un caffè caldo sul tavolo.
targetLang.de: ☕ Es gibt einen heißen Kaffee auf dem Tisch.

interactiveExercises.question: Choose the correct phrase to identify one object on the table:
options: There is a key on the table
There are a key on table

dialogues.prompt: 👂 Listen... 🗣️ There is a fountain in the town square!
dialogues.grammarUsage: Pointing out landmarks using existential verbs.

title: Daily Actions & Habitual Routines 🏃
rule: Present Simple Tense: Used for habitual routines and direct current states. Structure: [Subject] + [Base Verb/S-form]. Example: 'I walk to the town square every morning'.

examples.text: 🏃 I explore COSY Town every day.

targetLang.en: 🏃 I explore COSY Town every day.
targetLang.es: 🏃 Exploro COSY Town todos los días.
targetLang.de: 🏃 Ich erkunde COSY Town jeden Tag.
targetLang.ru: 🏃 Я исследую COSY Town каждый день.

examples.text: ☕ Lucas bakes fresh baguettes in the morning.

targetLang.en: ☕ Lucas bakes fresh baguettes in the morning.
targetLang.fr: ☕ Lucas cuit des baguettes fraîches le matin.
targetLang.es: ☕ Lucas hornea baguettes frescas por la mañana.
targetLang.it: ☕ Lucas prepara baguette fresche la mattina.
targetLang.ru: ☕ Лукас печет свежие багеты по утрам.

interactiveExercises.question: Which sentence correctly describes finding 3 objects?
options: I discover three objects in the city
interactiveExercises.explanation: First person singular 'I' uses the base verb form without 's'.

dialogues.prompt: ⚡ I discover items quickly! How many can you find?

title: Preferences & Requests ❤️
rule: Expressing Desires and Preferences: Use 'I like [Noun]' for general preference and 'I would like [Noun]' or 'I want [Noun]' for polite orders. Pattern: [Subject] + [Verb of Preference] + [Object].

examples.text: 🥖 I like fresh warm baguette from the bakery.

targetLang.en: 🥖 I like fresh warm baguette from the bakery.
targetLang.fr: 🥖 J'aime la baguette fraîche de la boulangerie.
targetLang.es: 🥖 Me gusta la baguette fresca de la panadería.
targetLang.it: 🥖 Mi piace la baguette fresca della panetteria.
targetLang.de: 🥖 Ich mag frisches warmes Baguette aus der Bäckerei.
targetLang.ru: 🥖 Мне нравится свежий теплый багет из пекарни.

examples.context: Expressing food preferences in shop contexts.

examples.text: ☕ I want a hot espresso, please.

targetLang.en: ☕ I want a hot espresso, please.
targetLang.fr: ☕ Je voudrais un café chaud, s'il vous plaît.
targetLang.es: ☕ Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
targetLang.it: ☕ Vorrei un caffè caldo, per favore.
targetLang.de: ☕ Ich hätte gerne einen heißen Espresso, bitte.
targetLang.ru: ☕ Я бы хотел горячий эспрессо, пожалуйста.

examples.context: Ordering drinks politely at the cafe.

interactiveExercises.question: How do you express a preference for bakery bread?
interactiveExercises.explanation: First-person 'I' takes 'like' in the present tense.

dialogues.prompt: 🥖 Warm baguette! 😋 Do you like fresh bread?
